prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Redesigning the sign_in page for clarity and account sync status was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win), though predictions (+10.0%) were slightly too high; other adoption page redesigns showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8% loss), and predictions (+5.0%) were far too high.
Layout changes on the choose_path page showed no clear effect, and predictions were too high.
Finish page modifications (redesigns and hints) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Home page modifications (tips carousels, waiting flows, and notification prompts) showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +8.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +7.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +2.7% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -5.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +4.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -2.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +8.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

0: [home, wait_info] Generation Stage Time Elapsed & Audio Signal: Add estimated time remaining and completion chime notification options during the pet creation wait screen.
